85a is done, so the queue wait is over. The go-or-stop call needs the split, pid and stall measurement. Player 2's largest gap during the 2000 ms host stall was about 2010 ms, and its p95 frame gap was about 33 ms.

The folder `notes/95/` doesn't exist, so no split numbers have arrived.

The alarm asking for the measurement is already in `alarms.md`. It also asks for the `party-pre95` tag and a fix for `party.cfg` `URL_OPTIONS=1` before any 95 ship. I added a line to my notes file.

Once the raw files are in `notes/95/` with a go, I'll build steps 2 to 7 behind the experimental switch, default off.
